sections.title: Typography
sections.description: This course explores typography in the context of other arts, styles and movements to understand how aesthetic and cultural values of a given period manifest themselves in the typographic form. We explore typography both as a means to organize information and as an expressive visual medium. The course format is divided between studio projects and seminar (lectures and discussions), including visits to the Rare Book Collection and the Common Press for presentations and workshops.

sections.title: Typography
sections.description: The study and practice of typography spans the history of individual letterforms through the typesetting of full texts. It is a complete immersion into type as an integral part of visual communication. Typesetting conventions and variables including legibility, readability, texture, color and hierarchy will be stressed, as well as a form for organizting information and expressing visual ideas. Studio work will include collection and analyzing type, designing an orginial typeface, researching type history and experimenting with typographic forms.
